optimizer: AdamW weight_decay=.0003, gradient clip1, per-module relative step cap .005
lr_policy: E166 baseline epoch 15, 3 stalled epochs per drop. Keep current S2 LR and state at unfreeze, reset plateau counters, prefix LR is 0.1x S2.
selection: Fixed dev500 own-Loss from a completed joint epoch after 20 protected epochs.
training_engine: Deterministic FP32 CUDA Graph for forward/backward and update projection; masked padding for 32-case tail, AdamW outside graphs. Share one selected MST per exit; deterministic matrix sum for selected endpoint gradients. Record parent indices during Prim, construct its edge mask once per exit. Share fixed-width same-group neighbor indices across the forward pass, and compute other-module bounding boxes using the two coordinate extrema per axis.
cache_policy: Read-only reuse of the original compatible full shared CPU static and public-role caches.

soft_count_proxy.aggregation: Per-case original no-MIB soft-constraint capacity; MST edge contact gap and worst required boundary-side gap per block

active_layers: L0-L8 pretrained prefix; fresh S2 used twice to L12.
